backdatedEmails.subject: Harborside Youth League fall registration invoice for the Brookfield Comets U11
backdatedEmails.body: Hello, this is the fall season registration invoice for the Brookfield Comets U11. Team registration fee: $360, due May 30. Invoice reference HYL2214. Please reply to this email once payment is arranged so I can mark your roster active for the fall schedule. Lenore Fairbanks, Registrar, Harborside Youth League
